390.bodyText: Access exclusive insights in the AI Momentum Report Login The new era of AP automation Meet the Vic.ai APSuite™ — the AI-powered platform for autonomous finance. Invoice Processing PO Matching Approvals Less manual work, more control with intelligent AP automation The Vic.ai APSuite™ revolutionizes AP with error-free data capture, faster approvals, and seamless payments — driving 5x greater efficiency across your entire process. Invoice Processing Universal invoice capture Universal invoice capture Seamlessly ingest and process invoices from any source — email, portal, EDI, or scan— with AI-powered universal invoice capture. Read More Superior data extraction PO Matching Multi-dimensional matching Intelligent issue detection Approval Flows Intelligent routing Approvals on Autopilot 2025 AP Automation Software Buyer's Guide Confidently evaluate and select AP automation software to drive more efficiency and achieve tangible ROI for your finance operation. Get the guide The Vic.ai APSuite™ A modern stack for core AP operations From invoice ingestion to payment execution, Vic.ai’s AI-first platform automates your entire AP process—eliminating inefficiencies, reducing errors, and delivering real-time insights for smarter decision-making. Invoice Processing Vic.ai extracts, codes, and approves invoices with unmatched accuracy — eliminating manual entry, reducing errors, and accelerating workflows. PO Matching Vic.ai intelligently matches invoices to purchase orders, ensuring accuracy and compliance while reducing manual effort and exceptions. Approvals Streamline invoice approvals with AI-driven recommendations, automated routing, and real-time visibility for more efficient decision-making. Achieve autonomous finance Take AP automation to new heights with AI Vic.ai isn’t just automating AP—it’s redefining financial operations. Our AI-first platform delivers visibility, control, and unmatched efficiency, ensuring your AP function is future-proof and built for scale. VicInbox™ VicInbox™ streamlines vendor inbox management to automatically capture, categorize, and process invoices eliminating manual sorting and ensuring seamless AP workflows. VicPay™ Automate and optimize B2B payments with VicPay™, ensuring secure, on-time vendor payments while maximizing rebates and cash flow efficiency. VicAnalytics™ Gain real-time, deep insights into your AP process with VicAnalytics™ that identifies bottlenecks, tracks processing times, and uncovers efficiency opportunities to optimize workflows and cash flow. Leading finance teams use Vic.ai to accelerate AP and scale for growth Vic.ai eliminated all the manual components of our payments process, providing each AP analyst with an additional 3 to 6 hours of capacity each week. Andrew Turkish VP and Corporate Controller, Diesel Direct Innovation is core to our ethos at Milwaukee Tool, down to the way our internal teams operate. We are excited to push the envelope with Vic.ai. It presents us with a great opportunity to incorporate AI and augment our decision-making. Conor Clair Senior Finance Manager of Accounting, Milwaukee Tool Our team needed to focus on higher-value accounting work instead of spending so much time on manual invoice processing tasks. Vic.ai was the clear choice for its ability to automate processing, improve visibility, and scale seamlessly with our growth.
